categories.main_business_segments: United Nova Technology Co., Ltd. (芯联集成) primarily operates in integrated circuit manufacturing with a focus on power semiconductors, MEMS, BCD, and MCU technology platforms. The company provides one-stop system foundry solutions including design services, wafer manufacturing, module packaging, application verification, and reliability testing. Its products serve automotive, artificial intelligence (AI), high-end consumer electronics, and industrial control sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as 8-inch and 12-inch silicon-based wafer production lines, SiC MOSFET manufacturing, and BCD process platforms. It has developed leading power IGBT, MOSFET, and SiC power semiconductor technologies, alongside MEMS sensor technologies including microphones, inertial sensors, and VCSEL lasers. The production integrates wafer fabrication, module packaging, and system-level assembly with a focus on high reliability and automotive-grade standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include automotive manufacturers and system suppliers, AI server and data center operators, industrial automation companies, and high-end consumer electronics brands. The company’s products are widely used in new energy vehicles, AI computing, industrial control systems, and smart consumer devices. It has established deep cooperation with major domestic OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and major manufacturing facilities located in Shaoxing, Zhejiang Province. It serves domestic markets extensively and exports to regions including Europe and Japan. Its supply chain and customer base are mainly concentrated in China, with strategic partnerships extending to Asian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: United Nova Technology operates mainly in the midstream semiconductor manufacturing segment, providing wafer foundry and module packaging services. It positions itself as a system foundry provider offering integrated solutions from chip design to packaging and testing, bridging upstream semiconductor materials and downstream device assembly and end-use applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in power semiconductors, MEMS, BCD, and MCU technologies, targeting growth in new energy vehicles and AI applications. It invests heavily in developing 12-inch wafer lines, SiC MOSFET platforms, and advanced packaging technologies. Strategic initiatives include expanding AI server power management chips, automotive-grade analog ICs, and sensor integration, supported by a strong innovation ecosystem and collaboration with government funds and industry partners.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of integrated circuits and modules, wafer foundry services, and related design and testing services. The company operates on a direct sales model, engaging customers through targeted marketing, technical seminars, and industry events. It also derives income from government subsidies and investment returns from equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: United Nova Technology is among the leading integrated circuit foundry companies in China, ranking as one of the largest automotive-grade IGBT producers and a top SiC MOSFET manufacturer in Asia. It is recognized as a top-five global MEMS foundry and ranks fourth in China’s dedicated foundry market. Its power module installation volume ranks third domestically in new energy vehicles. The company is positioned as a technology leader with a comprehensive product and service ecosystem.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved record revenue of approximately RMB 6.51 billion, representing a 22.25% year-over-year increase, with EBITDA growing 131.86% to RMB 2.15 billion. Despite still operating at a net loss due to high capital and R&D expenditures, it reduced losses by over 50%. Total assets reached RMB 34.2 billion, with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and technology upgrades. The company is in a rapid growth phase with strong market penetration in key sectors.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: United Nova Technology offers a unique one-stop system foundry service integrating design, wafer fabrication, module packaging, and testing, significantly reducing customer costs and time-to-market. Its advanced technology platforms in power semiconductors, MEMS sensors, and analog ICs provide high reliability and performance tailored for automotive and AI applications. The company emphasizes domestic innovation leadership, comprehensive product ecosystems, and strategic supply chain management to deliver differentiated, high-value semiconductor solutions.
